relationships.evidence_quote: It is widely demonstrated in the literature that ozone modulates oxidative stress and inflammation, through the stimulation of Nrf2, and the inhibition of nfkβ a key regulator of inflammation.

relationships.subject: ROS
relationships.evidence_quote: Excess ROS causes oxidative stress to activate several signaling pathways in disc cells, including the nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB) pathway and the Mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) pathway.

key_findings: Review proposing medical ozone as an etiological, epigenetic-like regulator of oxidative stress and inflammation in IVD degeneration, via Nrf2 activation and NF-kB inhibition.
Ozone proposed to shift macrophages from M1 to M2 and prepare microenvironment for progenitor cell implantation.
